sys_script_include.description: Read-only CMDB data access for the governance assessment. Supports local mode (GlideRecord/GlideAggregate) and remote mode (REST Table and Aggregate APIs over GET only, authenticated with a Basic or OAuth 2.0 profile). Exposes describe, instanceUrl, tableExists, fieldExists, count, groupCount, list and test.
sys_script_include.name: CMDBGovDataSource
